The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] was the site of a '''battle''' between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Wild Space" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The battle began seven [[Standard week/Legends|standard weeks]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the Confederacy launched a multipronged attack on the Republic. Following their [[Battle of Anoth (Clone Wars)|defense]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> of the multi-planet<ref name="">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]], [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] joined the defense of Bakura against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. During the battle a [[Unidentified traitor|traitor]] in the Bakuran government facilitated Grievous' [[Death/Legends|slaughter]] of the entire [[Ruling Synod]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], sometime after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], an [[Alinta|informant]] shared details of the Bakura traitor with [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. The [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] shared the information and the existence of the informant with fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Kenobi.<ref name="Wild Space" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
